name: CSE 6512
title: Randomization in Computing
description: Introduction to the theory and practice of randomization and randomized algorithms as a technique for science and engineering problem solving. Topics to be covered include: probability theory, types of randomization, sorting and selection, hashing and skip list, finger-printing, packet routing, geometry and linear programming, graph algorithms, combinatorial optimization, and external memory algorithms.
requirement_description: CSE 5500. Open to graduate students in the CSE program, others with consent.
